strategies.name: vwap_20sma_confluence_long
strategies.entry_summary: First two-minute candle off the bell closes over both the 20 SMA and VWAP; wait for a following candle to confirm that candle's high; enter long at the confluence of VWAP and the 20 SMA; buy bounces that wick into but do not close below VWAP; optionally add/DCA on pullbacks into VWAP.
strategies.exit_summary: Either scalp into the upper VWAP band for profits, or hold and trail the 20 SMA once price breaks away from VWAP, exiting on a close below the 20 SMA.

coverage_notes: Inventory item 1 (MANDATORY scalp-band exit ~15-20pt): PRESENT as targets[0] — verbatim 'sell for profits into the upper Channel' via the VWAP upper band; magnitude preserved verbatim ('15 20 points'), derived from the July 3 example (entry ~2,259 -> sell ~20275); exact prices nulled as example-only per the rule. Inventory item 2 (MANDATORY 20SMA-trail exit ~75pt): PRESENT as targets[1] — verbatim 'use the 20 SMA as a trailing stop ... if we do close below the 20 SMA ... get out of the trade'; magnitude 'almost 75 points' preserved verbatim, from the example day (20258 -> close below vwap 20331); exact levels nulled as example-only. Both mandatory exit units are carried in targets[] — neither silenced. Inventory item 3 (20-SMA-only short = counterfactual): ABSENT-WITH-REASON — the 20-SMA-only short is taught only as a COUNTERFACTUAL to argue VWAP confluence prevents a bad short ('if you were simply following the 20 SMA strategy well then you would have been into this short position here and then rudely been stopped out'). Separately, the speaker teaches a genuine rejection SHORT ('short the rejection of vwap and the 20 SMA' once both are lost and price builds below), which is the OTHER object of the Rule-2 pair and a SEPARATE strategy — deliberately not extracted here. Neither short belongs to this long object. Note: the garbled 'comp information' in entry_sequence[2] is the speaker's word for 'confluence'; 'vwob'/'V up'/'vop' are transcription artifacts of 'vwap' and left as spoken with a bracketed gloss.
